name: Yomi
source:
A sadist with a cold look who doesn't know what he's doing.

According to the demon [url=https://vndb.org/c113347]Neeco[/url], he seems to be trapped in a dream of trials due to the demon summoning ceremony he performed himself, but he doesn't remember anything she said...

[Translated from [url=https://romankessha.wixsite.com/sadisma]official website[/url]]
